# Package Hardening Report

## Scope

This report records Phase 5 professional hardening work for `enemduR`.

The work focused on documentation, package metadata, generated manual pages,
basic continuous integration, basic pkgdown configuration, and local package
validation. It did not add new indicators, change official statistical
definitions, run new official tabulation validation, compute poverty indicators,
or reconstruct labor condition from raw questionnaire variables.

## Commands Run

```r
devtools::document()
devtools::load_all(reset = TRUE)
devtools::test()
devtools::check()
pkgdown::build_site()
```

Fallback package-check commands were also run because `devtools::check()` was
blocked by the local Rtools preflight under R 4.6.0:

```sh
R CMD build C:\Users\yerov\Documents\dev\R\enemduR
R CMD check enemduR_0.0.1.9000.tar.gz --no-manual
```

## Results

- `devtools::document()` completed successfully.
- `NAMESPACE` was not modified because the existing file is hand-maintained and
  was not generated by roxygen2.
- Export/manual coverage check: 73 exports, 73 exported function definitions,
  zero exported functions without man pages.
- `devtools::load_all(reset = TRUE)` completed successfully.
- `devtools::test()` completed successfully: 549 passing expectations, 0
  failures, 0 warnings, 0 skips.
- `devtools::check()` did not complete because pkgbuild could not find Rtools
  matching R 4.6.0 in the local environment.
- Fallback `R CMD check --no-manual` completed with `Status: OK`.
- `pkgdown::build_site()` completed successfully to
  `C:/tmp/enemduR-pkgdown/dev`.

## Warnings, Notes, and Local Environment Issues

- The final fallback `R CMD check --no-manual` had no package check warnings,
  notes, or errors.
- R printed repository-index warnings after the check because CRAN and
  Bioconductor source indexes were unavailable from the local check process.
  These messages did not affect the `Status: OK` check result.
- `pkgdown::build_site()` reported that `_pkgdown.yml` has no `url` field. This
  is intentional until a public documentation site URL is confirmed.
- No README CI badge was added because the public badge URL and branch policy
  should be confirmed after the workflow is active on GitHub.

## Decisions Made

- Kept `.sav` as the operational primary format for recent official ENEMDU
  workflows and preserved `.dta` and `.csv` as interoperability formats.
- Updated `survey_registry.csv` from `dta` to `sav` in the file-format field to
  align package metadata with the current documented contract.
- Removed the obsolete `enemdu_kpi_employment()` placeholder so roxygen documents
  the implemented labor module instead of a stale stub.
- Preserved the implemented labor indicators based on consolidated `condact`.
- Preserved `domain_scope = "observed"` as the default.
- Preserved `domain_scope = "design"` as output filtering after estimation.
- Documented that official city-domain validation should use `dominio`, not
  `ciudad`.
- Kept Quarto as a downstream analytical consumer and documented current helper
  functions as reserved placeholder interfaces.
- Preserved UTF-8 literal source text for Spanish labels and messages so the
  source remains readable under the package `Encoding: UTF-8` contract.

## Limitations

- No new official statistical validation was run in this phase.
- The pkgdown site was built locally but not published.
- The GitHub Actions workflow was added locally but not run on GitHub in this
  phase.
- `devtools::check()` remains blocked in this local R 4.6.0 environment until a
  matching Rtools installation is available; the fallback `R CMD check` passed.

## Recommended Next Phase

- Run the new GitHub Actions workflow on GitHub and add a README badge only
  after the workflow name, branch policy, and badge URL are confirmed.
- Publish pkgdown only after a public site URL is selected, then add the `url`
  field to `_pkgdown.yml`.
- Keep official validation workflows external and auditable; do not claim new
  validation coverage unless the official comparison scripts are rerun and
  evidence is retained.
- Consider a release-preparation phase focused on CRAN-style metadata,
  licensing, examples, and public documentation polish.
